purpose.zh: 不用器械，用另一只手给阻力练二头肌
purpose.en: Train your biceps with no equipment, using your other hand for resistance.

text.zh: 另一只手压住前臂，慢慢对抗着弯举
text.en: Press down on your forearm with the other hand and curl slowly against it

text.zh: 手肘贴住身体，掌心朝上
text.en: Keep your elbow at your side, palm up.

text.zh: 下放时二头肌继续对抗，不要放松
text.en: Keep resisting with your biceps as you lower.

commonErrors.en: Letting the elbow leave your side.

cautions.zh: 肘部疼痛时减小用力，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Push more gently if your elbow hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
